characters.earlierSummary: Post-Crisis Diana in the winged golden eagle armor, a full suit with eagle helmet that she dons only for especially serious fights. In Wonder Woman Vol 2 she wore it while injured in the 1999 Devastation arc and against the universe-destroying Imperiex in Our Worlds at War (2001). Her flight, speed and strength remain her own Hermes- and god-granted powers; the sources do not credit the armor's wings with flight.

Circe trapped her in the Collective Unconscious and took control of her body during the Witching War

characters.earlierSummary: Diana as the most powerful of Hecate's Witchmarked. Marked by Hecate as a child, she carried a fraction of the goddess's magic, which lay dormant until the Upside-Down Man activated it. With it she banished that demon; Hecate later possessed her, but Diana retook her body, opened a portal for the Upside-Down Man to devour Hecate, restored the Sphere of the Gods and lost the magic.
